items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: We were the greatest of friends, of course

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, I remember that. That's quite a sound. That's -- you know, that's -- now when you -- did you begin to notice after you started using the bow that more bass players began using the bow in jazz during those years, or did the guys just continue to play mostly pizzicato?

Well, the fellows mostly continued to play, playing pizzicato. Maybe one or two bassists started using the bow after I had started, say like Major Holly. There's quite a story about old Major. We were the greatest of friends, of course, but Major told me during that time --
